title: Studio Gallery
purpose: Choose how to organize a Studio by studying real examples.
audience: People and agents starting a similar design
product: A searchable Studio gallery with main Draws, scope, and delivery links.
steps: Browse Skill and Page design examples.
Read the purpose and delivery contract.
Open its main Draw and unresolved choice.
Open the associated product and reusable configuration.
checks: Every example names a real source Studio.
The purpose and intended reader are visible.
The gallery does not use itself as an example.
example: Study Studio Skill, Studio Page, Mind Map Skill, Mind Map Page and Delivery Skill.
open: Should discovery start with a delivery type or a work scenario?
